title: Strata-bucketing per-domain contextual calibration packs for quant profiles
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Create a repeatable sampling strategy that produces compact, representative calibration packs per domain and per-tenant to drive FP8/INT8 quantization profiling and downstream accuracy validation. The goal is to replace monolithic reservoir approaches with strata-bucketing that respects prompt context windows, response length distributions, and temporal recency for production traffic.
background: Current calibration packs are either large reservoir samples or static domain aggregates. Both approaches produce noisy quant-profiles when deployed on diverse tenant workloads.

This ticket explores strata-based bucketing (by domain, prompt-length bin, response-length bin, and recency) with prioritized micro-samples to improve representativeness while keeping pack sizes tractable for CI and on-device calibration flows.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc approved by PM and Applied ML (link in links)

Prototype sampler generates per-domain packs of <= 10k prompt-response pairs preserving 95% of token distribution and 90% of model output quality relative to full production sample under INT8 and FP8 quantization tests
End-to-end pipeline produces calibration packs automatically from daily traffic TTL and can re-run for a given tenant or domain on-demand
CI job that runs quantization profile generation and top-3 accuracy regressions passes on runtime-1.20 branch
design_decisions: Use a multi-dimensional strata key: {domain, prompt_len_bucket, resp_len_bucket, recency_bucket}.
Bucket boundaries chosen from p10/p50/p90 token-length percentiles computed per-domain during sampling day.
Mix deterministic anchors (high-impact examples flagged by product signals) with randomized strata draws to ensure edge cases are covered.
Pack size cap default=10k examples; override via per-tenant config for enterprise customers.
Make sampler idempotent and seedable to allow reproducible calibration runs for regression tests.
sampling_algorithm: 1) Compute domain-specific histograms for prompt and response token lengths for the target time window (24h default). 2) Derive bucket boundaries using quantile estimates (p10,p30,p50,p70,p90). 3) Tag each interaction with a strata tuple (domain, p_len_bin, r_len_bin, recency_bin). 4) Allocate per-strata sample quota proportional to observed token mass, with minimum floor=2 and maximum cap=500 per strata. 5) Within each strata sample, prioritize examples with high utility score: signal = weight_traffic * usage_count + weight_errors * error_flag + weight_product * product_tag. 6) If anchors exist for domain/product, reserve 5% of pack for anchors. 7) Shuffle with deterministic seed and export pack in newline-delimited JSONL with metadata header.
evaluation_plan: Generate calibration packs for three representative domains: search-assist, customer-support-bot, code-completion.
Run quant-profile generation for INT8 and FP8 using runtime-1.20 kernels and capture per-layer activation ranges.

Apply quantized models to holdout eval sets (stratified holdout of 50k examples) and compute: exact-match rate, Rouge-L, token-level perplexity delta, and human-rated quality on 300 samples per domain.
Compare against baseline (full-sample quant profiles) and measure regression: target < 2% relative drop in human-rated quality and < 5% increase in failure modes for critical intents.
Automate metrics collection into console dashboard: quant-qa/pack-224466 (dashboard link in links).
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Prototype sampler and packs for internal eval (owners: Marco + Priya).
Phase 2: Run nightly pack generation for three pilot domains and schedule CI quant-profile runs (1 week).
Phase 3: Expand to top-20 domains and enable per-tenant override flags (3 weeks).
Phase 4: Merge sampler into calibration service and enable canary job that seeds dedicated runtime cohort with new INT8/FP8 profiles (requires infra approval).
blockers: Access: need staging role to read full-day prod logs for tenant-aware sampling (security ticket filed #SEC-1157).
Infra: quant-profile CI job currently times out for FP8 passes on current runner; require runtime test runner upgrade.
Data: product tags inconsistent across older logs; requires ingestion-normalization job (ENG-220100).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: smaller targeted packs reduce compute for profile generation but can miss rare long-tail intents; mitigations include anchor reserve and periodic full-day reservoir sampling.
We considered a clustering-based approach (semantic clusters via embeddings) but postponed due to embedding compute cost and stability concerns; revisit after pack pipeline matures.
Edge-case: extremely short prompts (<3 tokens) often correlate with multi-turn context; we will include conversation context window as a later enhancement.
PM feedback: ensure tenant opt-out for automated sampling; legal requested retention TTL alignment with policy.
Design review scheduled 2025-02-21; applied ML sign-off pending on evaluation thresholds.
